name: The Writhing Deep
summary: Among the backpacks lies a hurried note signed by Raschal of Feathermoon. He writes of bug-like creatures he came across, and of his decision to look into them himself. Your search for him now leads there.

sections.title: The Note in the Packs
sections.body: The backpacks hold a parcel meant for Thalanaar, and a note scribbled in a hurry to no one in particular. Its author, Raschal of Feathermoon, describes insidious bug-like creatures he discovered in the Writhing Deep, south of the gnoll camps. He felt he had to see them with his own eyes, for they seemed a grave danger to all of Feralas. The note shows where he went.

sections.title: What Waits Below
sections.body: In the Writhing Deep you come upon a large pod of an alien kind. Its surface looks mucous, with hardened growths jutting from it here and there. It is tall and broad enough to hold a person, and through its skin you can make out the faint shape of a humanoid, which you take to be what it holds.

faq.answer: Raschal of Feathermoon wrote the note found in the backpacks. He went to look into bug-like creatures he had discovered, and your search for him continues.

faq.q: Where is the Writhing Deep located?
faq.answer: Raschal's note puts the Writhing Deep south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.

faq.q: Why did Raschal go to the Writhing Deep?
aliases: why raschal went to the hive
faq.answer: His note says he found insidious bug-like creatures there and felt the need to investigate personally, since they looked like a grave danger to Feralas as a whole.
It follows The Woodpaw Gnolls, the step before it.
